statusNote: P0/P1 remain in progress. The existing Citation union contains only eight canonical semantic families after retirement of 37 provisional mixed/locator/relationship/extension directories. Shared persisted citation identity is distinct; SourceRef quote-selector encoding is preserved. No donor disposition or behavior parity is completed by removing obsolete APIs/tests. Verified mention composition and explicit receipt restoration pass local package gates; they do not attest semantic classification. Private ca1 production matches focused oracle equality and protocol vectors; artifact integration and full grouping remain open. Stable-ID document/resolution schemas validate graph coherence and structural receipt round-trips. Authority examples are optional mention/detached references. Receipt v2 separates decisions from ordered, repeated membership and explicit shared list IDs; detached semantic objects contain no source proof. Private persistence binds decisions and optional exact list nodes separately and rejects unverified custom keys. A private callback session now executes all five captured callbacks and matches 18 focused source contexts / 53 events through test adapters; production defaults now pass all 76 default contexts through that session and also serve the 18 custom traces. Work accounting is shared and operation-local. General host/alias/model mutation and final document/service integration remain open. Private document projection/restoration validates occurrence/default authority keys and shares source verification. Private resolver text helpers preserve frozen Unicode/punctuation and arbitrary-precision Id. pin behavior. The private default resolver matches 46 focused scenes and all 30 committed default resolution calls over all canonical families, totaling 76 semantic contexts and 210 mentions; original-source span/extraction proof stays separate. Exhaustive resolver/custom-resource proof, live artifact integration, Bluebook codecs, extension proof and the bounded parser remain unfinished. Sixteen additional callback mutation scenes expose empty/ordered/repeated/cross-group values and alias/detached requirements. All sixteen group/alias/retained-dictionary/detached scenes now match all thirty-eight events and final groups, including list slots and detached prior-full/member references. An operation-owned captured dictionary service serializes updates, preserves owned list handles and closes on success/failure/interruption. All sixteen final source snapshots have structural codec representation proof, including list sharing and detached nodes. Private scoped detached object issuance preserves registered object identity without source capabilities. Eight additional prior-full-list/pair scenes now match all thirty-one events and final groups/context. The captured owner preserves retained prior-full state and immutable pair-node identities, including equal-valued replacement. Eleven additional semantic/default-key mutation scenes are frozen. Eight stable-resource scenes now match complete event and semantic snapshots through owned writes; source anchors and mention IDs remain unchanged. Three mutable default-key scenes remain open, including duplicate entries for one resource object and an alternate edit that retains one group. A private bounded combined/general-key table now matches eight frozen CPython histories / sixty-two events, including exact comparison calls, duplicate key-object entries, deletion, growth and stored-hash resize. Full live hash production and callback-owner integration remain open, so the three mutable default-key engine cases are not promoted. General host/model mutation, comparison reentrancy, document identity integration and final projection remain open. The owned HTML worker now replays all 1,097 frozen outcomes and independently confirms all 859 launched child exits. A source-only cleaner sequence corpus adds 1,155 cases and 51 custom scenes covering lazy steps, live registry dispatch, retained callback state and non-string host values. The eleventh portable source component does not qualify target cleaner composition or complete canonical parity. Direct same-fiber comparison mutation now passes thirteen additional general-key dictionary histories, preserving lookup restarts, current values, retained side effects and bounded work. Unicode tables, retained registry work ownership and composed cleaner integration remain open. A private lazy cleaner executor now captures runtime/Clock, preserves host values, shares nested text reservations and rejects unissued/reused/restored spending handles. All 440 primitive text vectors run through reserved stages without reapplying the raw-source ceiling to intermediate text. Global admission, default runtime ownership, full custom replay, maps and public Layer remain open. The private cleaner ledger now lends exclusive remaining capacity to captured bounded producers, including zero-capacity empty output and cleanup before waiting reservations resume. Global admission and full cleaner ownership remain open. The native HTML stage now borrows shared remaining output capacity, including zero, accepts intermediate text and preflights complete framing before payload allocation. Reproducible authenticated ABI/host/protocol input bounds cover the existing produced-text ceiling; full live cleaner ownership/replay and global admission remain open. Native byte detection and stage composition now use the pinned oracle GNU libiconv 1.17 backend with matching full encoding inventory and UTF-8 locale. A supplemental source report retains 589 byte cases and 45 non-text dispatch controls; direct byte outcomes match without new waivers. Complete LGPL source, reproducible relink objects and sixteen notices accompany the native asset. Full live value/registry/identity ownership, complete sequence/non-text replay and global admission remain open. Captured cleaner values now preserve 340 pinned text identity/subclass observations, and concrete builtin invocation replays all 45 input-kind controls without coercion. Original/frozen handle ownership, bounded empty/space caches, scoped retirement and unchanged-value production charges are verified. Live Python registry/cursor ownership, all 1155 sequence cases and global engine admission remain open. The captured dictionary backend now preserves thirteen combined Unicode/general-key histories and forty complete outcomes, including conversion before lookup and mutation restart. Local probe guards reset per outer call while captured aggregate work remains enforced; retained insertion identities use the safe-integer ceiling. Production string/byte hashes, live cleaner registry/cursors and full sequence replay remain open. Frozen Python primitive hashes now preserve 1056 complete vectors, including explicit one/two/four-byte Unicode storage and two surrogate-pair controls. Captured methods stream bounded inputs and preserve Clock/deadline/cancellation behavior; complete SipHash MIT attribution is retained. Source Unicode value ownership, object protocols, live cleaner registry/cursors and full sequence replay remain open. Exact Unicode source composition now retains 2016 histories and 6412 native-storage/identity snapshots; portable audit has twelve components. Target Unicode ownership remains unfinished.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until the packet rebaseline, implementation, corpus, transforms, proof, reflection, and lifecycle update ship in one PR driven to mergeable through bun run beep yeet repair, verify, publish --message, and monitor.

phases.name: Source baseline and exhaustive capability accounting
Differential, span, transform, regex, and repo verification
Close one Yeet PR to mergeable

verificationCommands: git diff --check origin/main...HEAD -- goals/citation-extraction-engine goals/INDEX.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
stopConditions: Either prerequisite contract is absent, incompatible, or accessible only through raw generated files.
The pinned canonical oracle cannot be executed, licensed, normalized, or accounted for case by case.
Parity would require a second public citation hierarchy, hosted truth, weakened exact-source fidelity, or unbounded execution.
A claimed reversible transform would need to invent missing information.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, unauthorized cost, destructive side effects, or broader product authority.
